title: For each instance display name that appears both (a) on host 'blaze8-12' am
question: For each instance display name that appears both (a) on host 'blaze8-12' among non-deleted instances with instance_extra metadata and (b) among instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime' and that have an instance_system_metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', show the host 'blaze8-12' memory variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (MB) alongside the 'prime' image-type average memory and variance (MB), ordered by the host 'blaze8-12' memory variance descending. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH host_instances AS (
  SELECT i.display_name, i.memory_mb
  FROM instances i
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND i.deleted = 0
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM instance_extra ie WHERE ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid)
),
prime_instances AS (
  SELECT i.display_name, i.memory_mb
  FROM instances i
  WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM instance_system_metadata ism
                WHERE ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type')
),
common_names AS (
  SELECT hi.display_name
  FROM host_instances hi
  INNER JOIN prime_instances pi ON hi.display_name = pi.display_name
),
host_stats AS (
  SELECT hi.display_name,
         VARIANCE(hi.memory_mb) AS host_variance,
         STDDEV(hi.memory_mb) AS host_stddev
  FROM host_instances hi
  WHERE hi.display_name IN (SELECT display_name FROM common_names)
  GROUP BY hi.display_name
),
prime_stats AS (
  SELECT pi.display_name,
         AVG(pi.memory_mb) AS prime_avg_memory,
         VARIANCE(pi.memory_mb) AS prime_variance
  FROM prime_instances pi
  WHERE pi.display_name IN (SELECT display_name FROM common_names)
  GROUP BY pi.display_name
)
SELECT hs.display_name,
       hs.host_variance,
       hs.host_stddev,
       ps.prime_avg_memory,
       ps.prime_variance
FROM host_stats hs
JOIN prime_stats ps ON hs.display_name = ps.display_name
ORDER BY hs.host_variance DESC

  JOIN common c ON c.display_name = i.display_name
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' AND i.deleted = 0

),
